plan.title: Liver treated vs control DE + pathway enrichment (n=3)
plan.analytical_narrative: Salmon-derived raw gene-level counts (12000 genes x 6 samples: 3 treated, 3 control liver samples, single batch, unpaired) are analyzed with the DESeq2 workflow recommended for a two-group fixed-effect design at the low end of replication. Step 1 runs sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA on top-variance genes, sample-distance heatmap, library size check) before any modeling, to catch an outlier or mislabeled sample given the very small n. Step 2 applies a minimal count pre-filter and fits the DESeq2 negative-binomial model with median-of-ratios normalization internal to the model, an explicit condition factor with control as the reference level, and the Wald test; log2 fold changes are shrunk with apeglm, and BH-adjusted p-values with independent filtering define the differential expression set at alpha=0.05. Because the smallest group holds only 3 replicates, the knowledge base flags materially reduced power (R-0017/R-0094): a second, cross-checking model (edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same filtered counts and design) is run in step 3 so the report can present the DESeq2/edgeR intersection as the higher-confidence gene set, per R-0042. Step 4 takes the full ranked gene list (Wald statistic) into fgsea preranked GSEA against the MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets (50 sets, symbols, 2026.1 release, staged locally) with Reactome as a stated follow-up collection, honoring the rule that at n=3 an over-representation test on a short significant-gene list is underpowered and a full-list ranked test is preferred. Step 5 compiles the final report: DE gene tables (unshrunken and shrunken LFC, SE, padj), MA/dispersion diagnostic plots, p-value histogram, the explicit power caveat for n=3 per group, the DESeq2-edgeR overlap, enrichment leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record (session info, package versions, gene set collection version, seed).

steps.method: DESeq2 vst(blind), PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes
Minimal pre-filter: keep genes with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size

fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
Reproducible report with power caveat for n=3, DESeq2+edgeR overlap, diagnostics, enrichment leading edges
